description: s441 round 4 control. A handler with an awaited server call and an inner `(event) => …` parameter and a block-local `const event` (different bindings) compiles: the event poisoning follows the handler's event BINDING (scope-resolved), not the name, and applies only after the first await.
rationale: §13.2: the rule concerns the handler's own event parameter after its first await; other bindings named `event`, and uses before the await, are unaffected.
